# Color Correction SOP (Real Estate)

Use when the user asks for “professional color” or consistent look across rooms.

## Goals
- Neutral, inviting interiors (clean whites, believable skin if present)
- Consistent exposure/WB across cuts
- No crushed shadows or clipped highlights

## Practical workflow
1) Prep
- Work on stabilized/selects timelines.
- Turn on scopes (waveform + vectorscope).

2) Primary balance (per shot)
- Set exposure with waveform (keep highlights controlled).
- Set white balance/tint (watch neutrals: walls/trim).
- Set contrast/pivot gently; avoid harsh blacks for real estate.

3) Saturation and hue sanity
- Add modest saturation after balance.
- Watch for over-saturated greens/teals and orange shifts.

4) Shot matching (room consistency)
- Match within a room first, then between rooms.
- Use split-screen/wipe comparison as needed.

5) Cleanup
- If noise is obvious, handle before heavy sharpening.
- Avoid sharpening halos on blinds/railings.

## QC checks
- White walls stay neutral across shots.
- Window highlights don’t clip aggressively.
- No hue jumps between adjacent cuts.

## References
- Use `docs/editing_books_structure.json` to locate color-related sections in `Editing-Books/`.
- Do not quote book text; convert to original checklists and settings guidance.
